'''Typhoeus's Archery Range''', also known as the '''Archery Range''', is a [[Facility (Regional Development)|facility]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

Typhoeus's Archery Range allows players to take control of [[Typhoeus]] and use the [[Archery]] tool to shoot moving targets within a set time limit. The activity features two modes: '''Simulation''', consisting of one-time challenges that provide permanent rewards, and '''Daily Exercise''',  consisting of challenges that reset every server day. 

As a facility, Typhoeus's Archery Range can be can be upgraded using [[Wuling Stock Bill]]s to unlock additional activity stages as well as recipes for Archery-based [[Personal Device]]s.

{{Quote|The hunt may have stopped, but the huntress never ceases improving her archery skills.}}

== Participation Criteria ==
In the side mission [[Cliffbottom Archery Range]], complete [Unlock the machine] to unlock this mode.

{{Color|※ Complete side mission [[A Dreamscape Shattered by Her Arrow]] to unlock side mission [Cliffbottom Archery Range].|9}}

== Chips ==
'''Chips''' are the types of projectiles that are shot using the Archery tool. Different chips can be unlocked by upgrading the facility and completing the specified training stage. Unlocking a chip through the facility also unlocks the chip as an equippable [[Personal Device]] which alters the properties of the projectiles fired when using the Archery tool.

In '''Simulation''' mode, '''Basic Training''' stages have pre-selected chips while in '''Advanced Training''' stages, players are able to select any two chips for each stage. In '''Daily Exercise''' mode, players are also able to select any two chips for each stage. Note that for '''Daily Exercise''' mode, some chips may work differently than their base description based on the current stage's mechanics.

== Simulation ==
=== Basic Training ===
'''Basic Training''' stages are stages which teach the player how and for what situation to use a specific chip. Completing a stage unlocks the chip as an equiappable Personal Device which alters the properties of the projectiles fired when using the Archery tool. Basic Training stages have pre-selected chips which cannot be changed.

== Daily Exercise ==
Daily exercises offers four levels that can be challenged with no restriction and Arrow Chips of the player's choice. Daily Exercises 01, 02 and 03 each feature the same stage (Target layouts) every day while cycling through a list of possible stage mechanics, for a total of 21 stage and mechanics combinations. Daily Excercise 04 cycles through 5 stages with three possible stage mechanics each, for a total of 15 unique stage and mechanics combinations. Additionally, Daily Excercise 04 has a daily leaderboard where players can compare their time with friends and preset NPC times.

Each Exercise has 3 Exercise Goals in the form of a time clear limit. Fulfilling each goal grants the players 1★. Clearing a higher tiered Exercise automatically obtains 3★ for all lower level exercises, even if the higher level clear is not 3★. Stars obtained are relevant for the [[Trial of the Bow]] event missions and [[Typhoeus's_Archery_Range#Path_of_Glory|Path of Glory]] Medal, but otherwise do not grant any rewards and are not saved.

'''Typhoeus's Archery Range''' can be upgraded using [[Wuling Stock Bill]]s to unlock additional activity stages as well as recipes for Archery-based [[Personal Device]]s.

== Events ==
[[File:Trial of the Bow event.png|center|400px|link=Trial of the Bow]]

{{Main|Trial of the Bow}}
'''Trial of the Bow''' is an exclusive limited-time event for the [[Dreamscape of Wind and Snow]] version that launches at the same time as '''Typhoeus's Archery Range'''. During the event, complete specific challenges in '''Trial of the Bow''' to claim rewards such as [{{I|Oroberyl|gv=false}}], [{{I|Mark of Perseverance|gv=false}}], [{{I|Advanced Progression Selection Crate I|gv=false}}].
